g000.content: The only release tagged on BrowserOS's GitHub is the BrowserClaw extension, correcting the assistant's earlier claim about BrowserOS releases.
g000.title: BrowserClaw extension is the only tagged BrowserOS GitHub release

g001.content: The MCP browser adapter must be fixed to point at BrowserClaw's actual endpoint and port instead of 9000.
g001.title: Fix MCP browser adapter to target BrowserClaw's real port

g002.content: Lexicon uses a single shared C-family adapter for C and C++ rather than separate C and C++ adapters, with each file's language reported as c or cpp.
g002.title: Lexicon uses one shared C-family adapter for C and C++

g003.content: Proceed with calibrating the C-family Lexicon adapter using git.git and CBM as the calibration corpora.
g003.title: Calibrate C-family adapter on git.git and CBM
